stages.log: The Provost has a warrant with your name on it. Lose the warrant, square it with your old ship, and the Provost has nothing to go on. Mother Ilse's job, on the board: lose your warrant in the Provost's filing.

objectives.text: Win A clerk's favour on the board

stages.why: The ship launched: the job went to someone else.

stages.log: Your warrant is in the wrong drawer under the wrong name. The Provost will find it, eventually. The Resolute, your old tender, short of spares: marked on the chart.
stages.why: The run left the charts behind.

stages.log: The Provost's courier, within reach of the colony: her MPs hold her.
